subject.title: fix(polls): reject polls with fewer than two options

question: Should the public `openclaw/plugin-sdk/channel-actions` helper throw for fewer than two options, or remain a computation-only helper with validation owned by `normalizePollInput` and sender boundaries?
rationale: Both choices are internally viable, but the answer establishes the permanent behavior of a public plugin SDK export and cannot be inferred solely from the bundled Discord and Telegram call paths.

options.title: Adopt the invariant in the helper
options.body: Merge the PR so direct plugin callers fail early with the existing canonical poll-validation error before they can use an impossible selection count.

options.title: Keep validation at normalization boundaries
options.body: Close or revise the PR so the helper remains number-returning and sender/plugin code must call `normalizePollInput` before delivery.

recommendation.title: Adopt the invariant in the helper
recommendation.body: Merge the PR so direct plugin callers fail early with the existing canonical poll-validation error before they can use an impossible selection count.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision concerns the shared public plugin SDK contract rather than one channel implementation.
